chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Al-Husayn ibn Saeed, from Fazalat, from Aban, from Abdul-Rahman ibn Sayabat, who said:

I said to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), 'Can I supplicate while I am in prostration (sajdah)?' He said, 'Yes, supplicate for the world and the Hereafter, for He is the Lord of the world and the Hereafter.
ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to make dua while in sajdah?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Kafi highlights the permissibility of supplication during prostration, with the Imam specifically encouraging the inclusion of worldly affairs alongside spiritual ones. This reflects the Shia emphasis on the holistic nature of worship, where the Divine Lord of both realms is invoked for comprehensive well-being. The advice underscores the unity of divine sovereignty over all aspects of existence.
